description: This file defines the WorkspaceSwitcherForm class in Drupal, providing a form to switch between different workspaces within the Drupal site. It includes form building, submission handling, and workspace management logic.

classes.name: WorkspaceSwitcherForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class that allows users to switch between different workspaces, including activating a selected workspace or switching to the live site.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for workspace management, entity storage, messaging, and selection plugin management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the workspace switcher form with options to select and activate a workspace, and switch to live.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission to activate the selected workspace, with access control.

methods.name: submitSwitchToLive
methods.description: Handles the action to switch the site to the live version.
